title: TodayWeather for Android · Current temperature
scenario: Hourly weather for a saved place in Celsius. This example uses the Seoul weather fixture in the native Android forecast view.

steps.title: Read the current temperature
steps.instruction: Open Hourly Weather (시간별날씨) and look beside the sky icon near the top of the screen.
steps.caption: The Seoul forecast shows 3.3 degrees Celsius.
steps.expected: The decimal point and the digit after it use 70% of the whole-number font size. The entire number sits on one baseline.
